Failure Mode: Worker restart/OOM mid-task; acks_late=False and no retry
Effect: Task lost with message already acked; client polls PENDING forever
Current Mitigation: None — task is acked on receipt
Proposed Mitigation: Set acks_late=True, task_reject_on_worker_lost=True, bounded autoretry max_retries=2 (after making task idempotent)

Failure Mode: result_expires=3600; Story row persists metadata only
Effect: Finished story content discarded after 1h; user permanently loses a paid story
Proposed Mitigation: Persist full story_text and pages to Story row; serve task-status from DB when Celery result expired

Failure Mode: Silent failures raise no exception
Effect: Beat skip, result expiry, all-fallback, queue growth never alert
Proposed Mitigation: Emit explicit metrics: static_fallback rate, queue depth, purge heartbeat; alert on thresholds

Failure Mode: Backup restore never tested
Effect: Untested backup may fail when needed; possible total data loss
Proposed Mitigation: Perform restore drill into scratch environment; document time-to-recover; write runbook RB-4

Failure Mode: maxmemory-policy may not be noeviction (unconfirmed)
Effect: Queued Celery messages and results evicted -> silent task loss
Proposed Mitigation: Verify and set maxmemory-policy noeviction; alarm on evicted_keys > 0

Failure Mode: Sync-timeout orphan thread plus async fallback dispatched
Effect: Double Gemini spend and duplicate Story rows per timed-out request
Current Mitigation: None — shutdown(wait=False) abandons the running thread
Proposed Mitigation: Make generation idempotent on client request key; on sync timeout reuse same task handle, do not dispatch a new one

Failure Mode: Sync generation holds 1 of 2 gunicorn workers up to 75s
Effect: 2 concurrent requests stall whole API; healthcheck fails -> restart
Proposed Mitigation: Default to async generation; raise worker count or move to gevent; keep sync for low-latency only

Failure Mode: Dyno restart / redeploy
Effect: In-flight async tasks (W1) and HTTP requests dropped
Proposed Mitigation: Fix W1 acks_late so restarts are survivable; deploy in low-traffic windows

Failure Mode: celery-beat service not in railway.toml; celery_config.py comment claims embedded -B
Effect: IaC rebuild loses beat -> retention purge silently stops
Proposed Mitigation: Add celery-beat service to railway.toml; correct misleading comment in celery_config.py

Failure Mode: Beat runs but purge firing never verified
Effect: Daily COPPA retention purge can silently stop with no alert
Proposed Mitigation: Purge task writes last_run heartbeat; alert if stale > 36h

Failure Mode: Volume backups staged but active state unconfirmed; restore only same project/env
Effect: Possible no backups; no off-Railway disaster recovery
Proposed Mitigation: Confirm backups active in dashboard; add periodic off-Railway pg_dump to R2/S3 before paying users

Failure Mode: backup_database.py writes to ephemeral /app/backups, never scheduled
Effect: Dead code implies a backup exists when it does not
Current Mitigation: None — script is not wired to any scheduler
Proposed Mitigation: Delete the script or wire it to an external bucket with a real schedule

Failure Mode: Stacked retry layers: client retry + sync-to-async fallback + last-resort sync retry
Effect: One request can trigger up to 3 generations
Proposed Mitigation: Single client-supplied idempotency key deduplicated across all retry layers

Failure Mode: Outbound checkout.Session.create has no idempotency_key
Effect: Client retry creates multiple checkout sessions / duplicate-subscription risk
Proposed Mitigation: Pass a Stripe idempotency_key derived from user_id + tier + time window

Failure Mode: Outage -> OpenRouter -> static fallback with no user-facing signal
Effect: Paying user silently receives a generic 4-page story
Proposed Mitigation: Surface provider/fallback state to user; alert on static_fallback rate

Failure Mode: Both providers down or OPENROUTER_API_KEY unset
Effect: Every story becomes static fallback; no static-fallback-rate alert
Proposed Mitigation: Alert on static_fallback rate; health-probe both providers

Failure Mode: Single worker, --pool=solo, concurrency 1
Effect: Throughput bottleneck; queued users wait up to 600s each
Proposed Mitigation: Add worker replicas or concurrency; separate queue for retention vs generation

Failure Mode: /health is shallow (no DB probe)
Effect: Bad deploy with broken DB passes healthcheck and goes live
Proposed Mitigation: Add a lightweight DB probe to /health or run a post-deploy smoke check

Failure Mode: Image request can run 120s == gunicorn --timeout 120
Effect: Worker killed mid-request; request dropped
Proposed Mitigation: Lower image timeout below gunicorn timeout; move image gen fully async

Failure Mode: Pool 10 + overflow 20 per worker ~90 conns vs ~100 Postgres limit
Effect: Connection exhaustion under load -> 500 errors
Proposed Mitigation: Right-size pool to worker count and Postgres max_connections; monitor checked-out connections

Failure Mode: Outage while STORY_GEN_PROVIDER=openrouter (no Gemini fallback)
Effect: All stories become static fallback
Current Mitigation: auto mode exists for rollback-safe migration
Proposed Mitigation: Keep auto mode in incidents; alert on provider error rate

Failure Mode: Hung provider call held to task_time_limit=600s then SIGKILL, no retry
Effect: Task lost after a 10-minute hang
Proposed Mitigation: Lower soft time limit; add bounded retry; tighten provider request timeouts

Failure Mode: checkout.session.completed carries bare subscription ID
Effect: current_period_end stored as None until first subscription.updated
Proposed Mitigation: Expand subscription on session retrieval, or always retrieve to populate period_end

Failure Mode: No migration framework; hand-run scripts, no transaction/rollback
Effect: Bad migration -> manual recovery, possible partial schema
Proposed Mitigation: Adopt Alembic; run migrations transactionally in the deploy pipeline

Failure Mode: db.create_all() on startup
Effect: Schema drift; dropped/renamed columns never reconciled
Proposed Mitigation: Replace create_all with managed migrations

Failure Mode: Backend down beyond Stripe ~3-day webhook retry window
Effect: Event permanently dropped -> subscription state desync
Proposed Mitigation: Periodic reconciliation job comparing Stripe subscriptions to local state

Failure Mode: Crash-loop exhausts restartPolicyMaxRetries=3
Effect: Service stays DOWN until manual intervention
Current Mitigation: Security assertions fail fast on bad config
Proposed Mitigation: Downtime alert (already specified in RAILWAY_ALERTS_SETUP.md); pre-deploy config validation

Failure Mode: Webhook secret rotation undocumented; code reads single STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
Effect: Rotation creates a window where all webhooks return 401
Proposed Mitigation: Support dual signing secrets during rotation; document the rotation runbook

Failure Mode: Per-image pricing ~0.0375 USD; retry loop
Effect: Image-generation cost spike
Proposed Mitigation: Cap retries; alert on per-day image spend

Failure Mode: Worker initializes Sentry lazily on first task
Effect: Early worker-boot crash before first task is not reported
Current Mitigation: create_app initializes Sentry on first task
Proposed Mitigation: Initialize Sentry in the Celery worker bootstrap explicitly

Failure Mode: Redis outage (SPOF: broker + results + rate limit + quota)
Effect: No async story generation until Redis recovers
Current Mitigation: Sync path still serves; security assertion requires REDIS_URL
Proposed Mitigation: Monitor Redis health; document RB-5; consider managed Redis with failover at scale

Failure Mode: Stripe API outage during checkout/portal create
Effect: User cannot subscribe; 500 returned
Proposed Mitigation: Retry with backoff; show a friendly retry-later message

Failure Mode: Quota / 429 ResourceExhausted
Effect: QUOTA_EXCEEDED surfaced to user
Proposed Mitigation: Per-user quota smoothing; alert when project-level quota nears limit

Failure Mode: Access token expires after 1h offline
Effect: Brief re-authentication via 30-day refresh token
Proposed Mitigation: Acceptable; ensure client silently refreshes before expiry

Failure Mode: Inbound webhook double-delivery
Effect: Re-applied absolute writes; safe
Current Mitigation: event.id dedup + unique constraint + stale-event cursor
Proposed Mitigation: None required — already idempotent

Failure Mode: Single-region (asia-southeast1) outage
Effect: Full application outage
Proposed Mitigation: Accept at current scale; revisit multi-region after launch

Failure Mode: Redis outage degrades rate limiting / quota
Effect: Rate limit per-process only; quota falls to DB breaker
Current Mitigation: M-2 fail-closed DB cost breaker; per-process limit fallback
Proposed Mitigation: None required — already mitigated
